{"consolidated_memory":"DROPPED FRAMES IN realtime/ws/session.ts - SEVEN SEPARATE INCIDENTS

File: realtime/ws/session.ts (websocket session handling, realtime side)
Common signal across all incidents: frames missing from client sequence
Common repro: hold socket open through network flap
Common context: all work in same corner of the codebase; context carried over between fixes

INCIDENT 1 [2026-03-06]
Trigger: first request after cold start
Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
Fix: raised pool ceiling and put bounded wait queue in front of it
PR #2713, branch fix/dropped-frames-2
Result: throughput rose 14 percent, to 139 requests per second

INCIDENT 2 [2026-05-25]
Trigger: jobs scheduled across midnight boundary
Root cause: race condition in lazy initialisation
Fix: guarded initialisation with double-checked lock
PR #3180, branch fix/dropped-frames-3
Result: reclaimed 21 GB of blob storage

INCIDENT 3 [2026-06-10]
Trigger: sessions arriving through OAuth provider
Root cause: error swallowed by bare except handler
Fix: narrowed the exception handler and let the failure propagate
PR #5904, branch fix/dropped-frames-4
Result: cold start time dropped 71 percent, to 922 ms

INCIDENT 4 [2026-06-29]
Trigger: records carrying non-ASCII names
Root cause: missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
Fix: added composite index and backfilled data in batches
PR #7300, branch fix/dropped-frames-5
Result: backlog cleared 50 minutes after deploy

INCIDENT 5 [2026-07-14]
Trigger: input list came in empty
Root cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
Fix: capped retry attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
PR #7539, branch fix/dropped-frames-6
Result: p99 latency fell from 3.7 seconds to 343 ms

INCIDENT 6 [2026-07-18]
Trigger: payloads above roughly two megabytes
Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
Fix: normalised input to NFC ahead of the digest operation
PR #9883, branch fix/dropped-frames-7
Result: memory settled at 848 MB instead of climbing past 7 GB

INCIDENT 7 [2026-08-29]
Trigger: accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
Root cause: config loader reading the wrong environment file
Fix: made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
PR #9974, branch fix/dropped-frames-8
Result: flaky test went from 89 failures per hundred runs to zero"}
